note: Hebrew harish is plowing; "earing" (from Old English erian, to plough) is obsolete and now suggests ears of grain.

kjv: to preserve you a posterity in the earth
mine: to preserve for you a remnant on the earth
note: Hebrew she'erit means a remnant or surviving group; "posterity" shifts the sense from survivors now to descendants later.
Hebrew mazon is food or provisions in general; "meat" in 1611 meant food, but now suggests flesh.
